method: Read-only recheck of each supplier's own current pages through the founder's desktop browser pane (page text and same-origin fetches), 12 Nov 2026. No Atlas record, permission or publication state was changed. Where a page was silent or a figure could not be confirmed, the field is null and the gap is listed in 'unresolved'.
scope_rule: Only makers already publicly listed in the Garden Retreat Maker Explorer (supplier-publication-gate-v1) are eligible. TimberIN is excluded by founder instruction (12 Nov 2026) until Republic of Ireland delivery is verified. Preview-only or held suppliers (EcoSauna, Sauna Experts, Auroom Wellness, Cosy Cabins, MyCabin.ie, Sommarnoejen) are never eligible.

levels.supplier: A statement made on a supplier-wide page (delivery policy, about, services). It does not confirm any one product.
levels.product: A statement made on the product page itself for the named product.
